accepted: CLI/TTY presenter renders bounded server page rows and action ids
run delta/heartbeat/terminal/Unknown preserve cursor and retry semantics
payload/detail is not copied into display rows
one server-bound route serves /inbox, /read, /ack, /approve, /deny and detach plans
multi-session badges are projected from the bound server page and carry the server clock
approval decisions are bound to the server-issued challenge hash and offered decisions
denied: Unknown converted to automatic retry or terminal converted to cancel
presenter calls Broker/runner/process or mutates HumanTask/Approval
forged scope tokens, key=value pairs, --flags and scope: prefixes on an inbox line
client clocks, local counters and preselected answers carried by a server page
a decision verb on a target outside the server projection or a decision the server did not offer
read/ACK/snooze state borrowed as an approval or task decision
another session's line, or a dropped connection turned into cancel/resume
